notes:
Summary: Mid-market product analytics SaaS (B2B) evaluating Redwood Hosted API as fast path, then Dedicated for predictable throughput and data isolation. Primary goal: replace homegrown embedding pipeline + ad-hoc Pinecone usage with consolidated embedding service + managed vector store integration.

Background: 3-year-old startup scaling to ~450 customers. Heavy batch embedding jobs (nightly ETL), and low-latency semantic search in product UI. Current stack: self-hosted embedding workers (on prem/CLOUD mix), PostgreSQL for metadata, Pinecone for vectors (provisioned), custom scheduler for batch jobs. Cost and ops overhead rising; want simpler ops and predictable unit economics.

POC scope (current):
- Ingest 500k historical docs (product tickets, KB, release notes) via batch embedding job; validate throughput and retries.
- Real-time query path: sub-100ms 99th pct target for single-query semantic search (50 concurrent QPS).
- Integration test with Pinecone and optional Milvus connector to validate upsert/ttl semantics.
- Verify prefix caching / deduping effectiveness on repeated queries.

Technical constraints / asks:
- Throughput: nightly batch jobs need sustained embed throughput ~2000 docs/sec to finish window.
- Cost sensitivity: economics matter; team asks for projected $/1k embeddings and unit cost for inference vs quantized model on Dedicated.
- Model preferences: open models allowed; want L2 vs cosine toggles, vector dim stability; also explore hybrid reranking (small LLM + dense retrieval).
- Routing/fallback: prefer Hosted for dev/test, Dedicated for prod with automatic fallback to hosted if capacity is saturated.
- Data residency: EU customer subset requires EU-only residency for their data.

Recent activity / timeline (bulleted):
- 2026-02-18: Kickoff call (Fireflies ff_2026_02_18_ctai_kickoff). AE Jordan + SE Rina + CTO Emma on call. CTO: "we need predictable nightly windows — ops pain is killing velocity."
- 2026-02-21: Sent POC spec + ingestion sample. Drive: /drive/pricing_decks/ctai_pricing_v2.pdf
- 2026-02-27: POC check-in; ingest started, throughput uneven due to retries. (ff_2026_02_27_poc_checkin)
- 2026-03-02: SE observed vector dimension mismatch on legacy embeddings; Rina proposed migration script. Jira INF-9123 opened for ingestion failure investigation.
- 2026-03-06: Pricing worksheet reviewed with Finance. Asked for committed discount tiers for Dedicated.

Quotes / stickier notes:
- "If we can shave ops and make vector costs predictable, we can reallocate 2 headcount to product." — CTO Emma
- Team worried about cold-start latency and cache warm-up for nightly jobs.

Decision criteria / evaluation checklist (customer):
- End-to-end POC passes: batch ingest speed, query latency at 50 QPS, failing over to hosted without data loss.
- Pricing: clear committed tiers for Dedicated with breakpoints at 100k and 500k monthly embeddings.
- Security: SOC2 + SSO + KMS + EU residency options.
- Integrations: Pinecone connector parity, or a managed vector DB option with export capabilities.

Next steps (short):
- SE to deliver migration script and re-run nightly job on 2026-03-12 (done, results pending).
- Jordan to present Dedicated sizing + pricing options to Finance week of 2026-03-15.
- Schedule live exec demo for 2026-03-20 (requested by CTO).

Open blockers (notes):
- Legal needs clearer SLA language around data residency for EU subset.
- Product team wants a benchmark against their current $/embed cost (they provided sample billing).
- Need clarity on cold-start mitigation (KV cache priming approach).

Staging notes (human):
- Tone: pragmatic, cost-conscious, ops-heavy; will move from Hosted -> Dedicated once economics and residency confirmed.
- Champion: CTO Emma (technical), Product Lead Jonah (use-case owner).
